this_week._comment: Dated copies of this week's sessions in the Hevy folder 'This Week'. hevy_push_routines.py (full push, no --only) re-renders every session dated today or later. Next week: rewrite date, slot and title in place and push; the API cannot delete routines, so reuse these ids (add or leave spare ones as needed). The Race Week folder (4004133) is empty; delete it in the app. A session's optional 'note' (e.g. a race rule) leads that routine's note and its first exercise note.

sessions.title: U1 Upper A (Tue 10 Nov)
sessions.note: R+2 after the 8 Nov race: upper body only, as written.

sessions.title: Full B (Thu 12 Nov)
sessions.note: Moved from Wed 11 Nov (legs still sore, busy day). R+4 after the 8 Nov race, first lower session since it (guide/03 section 4.7): deadlift top set capped at RPE 7 however the legs feel. If 150 x 4 would pass RPE 7, stop at the load that is RPE 7 and log it; 1-2 back-offs at 93% of that. A top set below plan is a hold, not a miss.
